intro.fr: Yooka-Replaylee se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Yooka-Replaylee can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Publication de la version Yooka-Replaylee AP First Release 0.0.1, seule version au nom du jeu sur ce dépôt au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version Yooka-Replaylee AP First Release 0.0.1 is released, the only one named after the game on this repository as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Yooka-Replaylee figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Yooka-Replaylee is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
